description: Data and business rules: loading, validating and saving records. Knows nothing about HTML or HTTP.
Turns data into markup (ERB, Blade, Django templates, or a React component rendered on the server). Receives data; never fetches it.
Handles the request: reads the URL and parameters, calls the model, picks the view and the HTTP status.
Every navigation and form submission loads a new HTML document from the server.
Renders React elements to an HTML string without hydration markers, for pages that will never hydrate (emails, server templates).
Backbone, AngularJS and Ember moved models, views and controllers into the browser, with the server returning JSON. The step toward SPAs.
A route-level function in React Router 7 / Remix that reads params and returns data for the route component: the modern controller.
